2010.kid: A big switch in the middle of the data centre. Every cupboard of computers has two roads up to the middle; this switch takes the busy one, and a spare stands beside it in case it breaks.
2010.nerd: The aggregation layer of a three-tier data centre: a chassis switch where every access switch's 10G uplink ends, layer 2 stops and HSRP gives the servers their gateway. A standby twin waits beside it; spanning tree blocks the uplinks to it so the tree has no loop.
